title: How is Joseph Stalin connected to Steve?
description:
Five real pictures connect Joseph Stalin to Minecraft's Steve, through Churchill, the Queen, Angelina Jolie and Jack Black.

Joseph Stalin → Winston Churchill → Elizabeth II → Angelina Jolie → Jack Black → Steve

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yalta_summit_1945_with_Churchill,_Roosevelt,_Stalin.jpg
Photo 2 by Official photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Churchill_queen_Elizabeth_1953.jpg
Photo 3 by AP Photo/Anthony Devlin, pool, Fair use (commentary): https://abc7.com/post/photos-queen-elizabeth-honors-angelina-jolie/345841/
Photo 4 by AFP / Festival de Cannes, Fair use (commentary): https://www.festival-cannes.com/en/medialibrary/jack-black-angelina-jolie-and-dustin-hoffman-photocall-of-the-film-film-kung-fu-panda/
Photo 5, Fair use (commentary): https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:AMCM_Steve_glare.jpeg + https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Steve_(classic)_JE6.png
